title: Image Generation Prompt
description: Craft detailed, style-consistent prompts for AI image generation tools like DALL-E, Midjourney, or Stable Diffusion.
template:
Create a detailed image generation prompt for [SUBJECT OR SCENE].

Style direction: [PHOTOGRAPHIC / ILLUSTRATION / PAINTING / 3D RENDER / PIXEL ART / OTHER]

Mood: [E.G. WHIMSICAL / MINIMALIST / DRAMATIC / CALM]

Color palette: [E.G. EARTH TONES / NEON / PASTEL / MONOCHROME]

Composition notes: [E.G. CENTERED SUBJECT / WIDE LANDSCAPE / CLOSE-UP / BIRD'S-EYE VIEW]

Negative prompts to avoid: [E.G. TEXT / WATERMARKS / DISTORTED HANDS]

Output: One polished generation prompt and three shorter variations.
example:
Create a detailed image generation prompt for a cozy coffee shop on a rainy afternoon.

Style direction: ILLUSTRATION

Mood: CALM

Color palette: WARM EARTH TONES

Composition notes: WIDE LANDSCAPE THROUGH A WINDOW

Negative prompts to avoid: TEXT, DISTORTED FACES

Output: One polished generation prompt and three shorter variations.
tips: Specify the exact art style or artist reference for stronger consistency
Include camera or lens details for photorealistic prompts
Iterate by copying the strongest prompt and changing one variable at a time
